tweets: GHK-Cu: topical creams vs injected peptides. Where the evidence exists — and where it’s still thin. Thread:
Topical GHK-Cu creams have been studied for decades, primarily for cosmetic effects. The skin-level data is relatively robust.
Injected GHK-Cu, on the other hand, has far fewer studies. Most of the evidence comes from animal models and is preliminary.
A key difference: topical GHK-Cu stays local, acting on the skin. Injectable GHK-Cu has systemic effects — which means more unknowns.
Human data on injected GHK-Cu is sparse. We don’t yet have large, randomized trials to confirm safety or efficacy at scale.
Always physician-supervised. Always 503A-compounded. Never 'research peptides'. Labs and follow-up when clinically appropriate.
